hooks.command: root="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -n "$root" ] && [ -f "$root/bin/dos-hook" ]; then command -p sh "$root/bin/dos-hook" pretool --workspace .; rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && exit 0; fi; python -m dos.cli hook pretool --workspace . 2>/dev/null || python3 -m dos.cli hook pretool --workspace . 2>/dev/null || powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command 'python -m dos.cli hook pretool --workspace .' 2>/dev/null || { [ -z "$root" ] || echo "dos-hook: warning: no DOS hook backend could run; live DOS enforcement is fail-open.
